_comment: DVSA MOT history API credentials. Copy to configs/dvsa.json
(gitignored) and fill in the four values. The OAuth client_credentials
flow is used: streettracker dvsa-label calls the token_url at startup
to obtain a fresh Bearer (typical TTL 3600 s), caches it in memory,
and refreshes automatically when it expires.
Values come from the DVSA developer portal:
oauth.client_id: GUID, the Entra app registration ID
oauth.client_secret: the app secret (rotates per DVSA policy)
oauth.token_url: the tenant's Entra token endpoint
